description: In their neighboring houses, Pat and Mat tackle a lost key, flat-pack furniture, a failed mower, rubbish, a leaking roof and a troublesome door, treating suburban maintenance as a continuing engineering laboratory.

s05e01.description: A dropped gate key disappears into a drain, and Pat and Mat launch an increasingly elaborate retrieval operation to recover one very small object from one very inconvenient place.

s05e02.description: Pat brings home flat-packed furniture and Mat joins the assembly effort. Instructions soon become optional as the pair improvise their way through a growing pile of boards, fittings and alternative uses.

s05e03.description: When the lawn mower breaks mid-job, Pat and Mat experiment with other ways of cutting the grass, treating the unfinished lawn as a mechanical problem demanding an original machine.

s05e04.description: A major cleanup fills every available bin, so Pat and Mat turn rubbish disposal into a logistics problem and keep scaling up their methods for getting the accumulated mess away from the house.

s05e05.description: Rain reveals a leak in Pat's roof, bringing Mat over to help. A straightforward patching job becomes a rooftop exercise in access, materials and the pair's usual refusal to leave a problem merely half-solved.

s05e06.description: A door that keeps swinging shut finally locks Pat outside. With Mat's help, he tries to reach an upstairs opening and turns getting back into his own house into a full engineering exercise.
